checkout.yaml.name: Checkout with a promo code
steps: Tap "Cart"
Tap the element with accessibility id "promo_field"
Type "SPRING10" into the focused text field
TODO (Maestro runScript, not imported): runs JavaScript, which Mobster doesn't run. Look at the screen and do what this point in the flow needs, or nothing if it needs nothing
TODO (Maestro takeScreenshot, not imported): Mobster records a frame for every step of every run. Look at the screen and do what this point in the flow needs, or nothing if it needs nothing
Go back one screen with the Back button on screen, or by swiping from the left edge
Scroll down

expect.name: Cart is empty is not visible

notes: command 7 (back): iOS has no back key, so the step taps the Back button on screen or swipes from the left edge
2 commands became a step marked TODO: the first run (Smart) fills it, then replay keeps what it did; read that run's report before you trust the check

login-part-1.yaml.name: Sign in and open the profile (part 1 of 2)
steps: Tap "Sign in"
Tap the element with accessibility id "email_field"
Type "sam@example.com" into the focused text field
Tap the element with accessibility id "password_field"
Type "correct-horse" into the focused text field
Dismiss the keyboard
Tap the element whose text matches the pattern "Continue.*"

login-part-2.yaml.name: Sign in and open the profile (part 2 of 2)
steps: Tap "Sign in"
Tap the element with accessibility id "email_field"
Type "sam@example.com" into the focused text field
Tap the element with accessibility id "password_field"
Type "correct-horse" into the focused text field
Dismiss the keyboard
Tap the element whose text matches the pattern "Continue.*"
Tap the element with accessibility id "tab_profile"
Scroll down until "Log out" is visible

notes: assertions in the middle of the flow became 2 checks; each one replays the steps up to its assertions
the last 2 steps come after the final assertion, so no check runs them; nothing judges them
